title: Murderous Bee
description: have you wonder what happens if you gave a bee a gun? This is maybe what happens!
body:
This mod introduces the Murderous Bee—a new hostile mob that challenges players with aggressive behavior and unique combat mechanics. Alongside it, the Baby Murderous Bee spawns as a smaller but dangerous companion. To fight these threats, players gain access to custom gun and bullet items, allowing ranged combat with special effects like confusion, blindness, and wither applied to targets. The mod also features crafted recipes, immersive sounds, particle effects, and advancements that reward players for mastering the new content. Murderous Bee adds intense, balanced gameplay focused on combat and survival, enhancing Minecraft’s hostile mob variety with a fresh and challenging bee-themed enemy.
